fact: Statistics Mauritius states preliminary vital statistics, including 6,386 live births registered in January-June 2026 for the Republic, were extracted from the computerised system in place at the Civil Status Division.
The same issue reports 6,333 deaths registered in January-June 2026 compiled from the Civil Status Division's computerised system, per Statistics Mauritius.

The World Bank's SPI lists Mauritius as meeting SDG 17.19.2, birth registration at least 90% and death registration at least 75% complete (score 1), a national rate not tied to a digital system; dated by the 2024 survey round.
